race.description: Fastplast Building Supplies Country Boosted Hcp (C1)
race.comment: DIRTY DOES IT (6) settled well back from a good draw last time before closing well to finish fifth at Muswellbrook. Hitting his straps now third-up and will appreciate the anticipated tempo. Can pounce on them late. I AM STEFFI (8) was far too good for a maiden field last start at Grafton. McColm stays in the saddle with the 2kg claim and will be looking to spear across and lead again. Worth following up. SCULPTOR (1) returns and it's worth noting he filled a minor placing when first-up from last campaign at Goulburn. Fitter for two trials and gets a key booking in Heywood. Can play a major role. BE SOMEONE (3) was also an impressive maiden winner last time out at Taree. Is lightly raced and has plenty of scope for improvement. Have to take seriously.
